blocks.html: It can offer a cool and refreshing break from your usual trip, or encourage a more exciting splash on your everyday encounters. It can inspire peace and tranquility for your worn-out soul, or a rewarding and invigorating experience for those who are looking for more. The people of Iligan in Lanao del Norte sure knows how to value its acclaim as the Land of the Majestic Waterfall, and, rather appropriately, a new retail landmark from the country’s most progressive developers, Robinsons Malls, brings all things remarkable in one of Northern Mindanao’s fastest-developing urban cities with its 45th commercial development, the new Robinsons Place Iligan. Rejuvenating Design Inspired by the restful flow of the breathtaking Maria Cristina Falls, and some 23 other waterfalls in the area, the uplifting design of the new Robinsons Place Iligan follows the spirit that makes Iligan one of the leading eco-tourism hubs in the country. Featuring curvilinear architectural details found within the retail complex that limits the use of hard lines, the dynamic architecture and interiors of Robinsons Place Iligan, as imagined by world-renowned architecture firm ASYA Design Partners, goes out of the box of the average blueprint of hard-angled malls. This three-level full-service shopping mall complex has four major entrances and mindful escalators positioned to provide quicker and unobstructed access to the rest of the levels. The mall is also complemented by glass facades which encourage the warmth of natural light, up to the elevated ceiling, adorned by a wave-like canopy that offers a dynamic setting for its energy-efficient ambient LED lighting. While verdant terraces found in each floor landing of the tri-level space borrows from the thriving life of Iligan’s people and its environs, which encourages economic growth by remaining respectful of its land’s natural bounty. Robinsons Place Iligan’s thoughtful approach to its chosen retail habitat extends all the way to the mall’s al fresco area, where delectable gastronomic encounters and the freshest food finds are highlighted by a soothing water feature that flows through multiple levels into a peaceful garden pond. The new retail and lifestyle center marks Robinsons Malls’ empowering commitment to stay true to its chosen locations, by bringing the best of the natural environment in and the best of exciting retail experiences out. Rewarding Development The new Robinsons Place Iligan rises at a total of 77,756.23 sqm., 50,000 of which realizes Robinsons Malls’ revitalized model for a more synergistic retail development. Anchored by the mall’s tenants—Robinsons Supermarket, Robinsons Department Store, Robinsons Appliances, Toys R Us, Daiso, and Robinsons Movieworld, the new mall development is already hinting of rewarding shopping conveniences that will soon be available to Iligan’s communities. Bringing with it the most respected retail brands of the country and the rest of the world, the selections soon to be found at the new Robinsons Place Iligan is sure to be limitless. And with its commitment of encouraging homegrown enterprise in the places it does business in, Iligan’s new commercial landmark also reserves prime property space for the city’s most revered local businesses. But, going the extra mile in complementing the City of Iligan’s new mandate of attracting more and more tourists and investors, the new Robinsons Place Iligan features a 100-room Go Hotels which would offer restful and rewarding accommodations for business travelers and visiting tourists alike, attuned with the world-class quality hospitality that is akin to the Go Hotels brand around the country. Revitalizing Experiences And finally, the empowering new retail complex aims to bring the City of Iligan to the modern age, with unparalleled commercial experiences and encounters for its emerging consumers. Its 275-seater Food Gallery located at the third level brings in the most celebrated flavors across the country, whether they are fastfood options or home-cooked varieties. It elevates the feel of dining further by providing the breathtaking view of the mountain ranges through floor-to-ceiling glass windows, and its seats and tables can be rearranged to accommodate large groups or family gatherings. A visit to its well-appointed rest stops also proves to be a rewarding experience. With light-lined hallways that lead to resort-style restrooms designed with seamless entrances, luxurious vanity mirrors, modern toilets and commodes, and wide and spacious lavatories, the Robinsons Place Iligan flaunts how it puts most value on its patron’s comfort and quality of life. And, as the crowning glory of the new mall development, the Robinsons Place Iligan will house the most advanced, state-of-the-art movie theater in Northern Mindanao with the new Robinsons Movieworld. Replete with 6 cinemas, five of which are digital and one will be cutting-edge 3D, the spacious 4,000 square meter cinemateque with its light and airy box-office lobby, and its dynamic ambient-lit walls certainly showcase how the groundbreaking waves of modern entertainment start at the Robinsons Place Iligan. The new Robinsons Place Iligan also brings malling right into the future, by enhancing consumer interaction and experiences through digital apps and efficient customer service. The Robinsons Malls app brings the modern mall experience in your iOs or Android smartphone, extending the convenience of shopping and entertainment in your Robinsons Malls with only a few swipes. The app features store directory functions, Lingkod Pinoy listings, access to public transportation, and directions going to the nearest Robinsons Malls. It also extends the ease of your Robinsons Malls experiences with movie ticket purchase and seat selection, making your mall visit and movie watching a breeze. This digital malling convenience is extended with Robinsons Movieworld’s partnership with the country’s leading online directory, ClicktheCity.com. Now, Robinsons Movieworld Tickets can be purchased through the Click the City mobile app, and moviegoers can also book guaranteed movie seats in any of the Robinsons Movieworld branches nationwide. With much respect for the harmony of its environment, the innate values of its people, and the potential of its communities, the new Robinsons Place Iligan rises with a more rewarding take to Northern Mindanao’s retail encounters by showing the Iliganons that they can make the most out of life by celebrating what is completely their own.
